spec_match.rationale: Probes exactly the three members Chromium's html_image_element.idl ships behind RuntimeEnabled=UAImageReplacementAPI, and explains that exposure does not imply events (the anti-fingerprinting rule).

interactive.rationale: Re-probe button re-reads all four cells; flag steps show/hide from the genuine result.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises exact-member probing with trial steps; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes exposed-but-quiet from not-exposed, and warns against reading the probe as replacement-feature detection.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864 plus the explainer and the IDL.

conformance.rationale: Suite asserts the three members, the read-only false default, the no-trigger enumeration, untrusted synthetic events, and keeps the user-intent contract as an honest manual assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: cells read false with the honest not-exposed verdict and visible enable steps; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: uair-probe-ran assert records all three member readings.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; emerald/rose values on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Native button; status is role=status aria-live; cells are labelled text pairs.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Probe grid collapses under 640px with min-width:0 cells; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify the exposed state behind the flag on Chrome ≥152
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 predates UAImageReplacementAPI, so only the not-exposed branch could run. Relaunch a newer Chrome with --enable-blink-features=UAImageReplacementAPI and confirm the three cells flip true.

guidanceConsulted.query: live status readout updates aria-live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce probe outcomes through live regions.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive probe grid small screens no overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Single-column collapse + min-width:0 + wrapping for long member names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied (probe keys use overflow-wrap:anywhere); verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): honest not-exposed readout with exact enable steps on Chromium 141, clean console, both viewports. Flag-on verification is environment-blocked and recorded.
